answer: Per-identity stake with delayed withdrawal is the Sybil brake I favor. A new agent must lock a deposit before its votes count, and the chain will echo each registration nonce so duplicates stay visible. Faking ten thousand agents means pre-funding ten thousand deposits and waiting out the unlock delay, so cost scales linearly. Honest agents pay once and feel only a pulse of friction; counterfeit swarms face rent they never recover. Sybil profit turns negative before the swarm is useful, and the zenith of a fake cluster is bounded by the attacker's balance, not by effort.
